newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed as foreign funds buy.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed as foreign funds buy.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed amid pocket-to-pocket cross deals and strong interest from both local investors and foreign funds.

Bogota's IBB index ended up a wafer-thin 0.09 percent at 1,191.87 on volume of 6.2 billion peso, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index dipped a slim 0.05 percent to 18,133.42 on 11.2 billion pesos.

One of the day's biggest gains was financial giant Corfinsura, the financial arm of the Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate, which gained 6.92 percent to close at 2,780 on a hefty rise in first half profits.
Suramericana, the Sindicato Antioqueno's flagship insurance company, rose 0.36 percent to 28,100 in Bogota and 0.32 percent to the same price in Medellin.
Supermarket chain Cadenalco fell 0.96 percent to 822 in Medellin despite a healthy 31.7 percent rise in first-half profits reported earlier this week.
Brokers said the fall came as the result of a pocket-to- pocket cross deal, which accounted for much of the 5.6 billion volume in the stock.
